discovery.help:
hybrid-axi quota
Artium manages the API key and fixed Hybrid Analysis origin. Submissions, YARA mutations, consuming matches and the four reviewed archive downloads are off by default and selected independently; administrator-enabled operations still require native preview, --execute, exact --confirm and journal. Quick scans transmit the supplied sample or URL as read exceptions. File flags accept uploaded leaves; body-file also accepts explicit stdin (-). Use artium-axi download --help for authenticated one-shot CLI verified saving and live-malware warnings.
